content.text: **Finding: deviation (MFN)** — Section 7.2 (¶p0027) imposes an open-ended most-favoured-nation obligation on us, requiring Redwood to offer Silverline terms no less favourable than the best terms given to any other technology supplier. With no product, term or comparison limits, it fails the fallback and falls into walk-away territory, and it directly contradicts Section 12.3, where Vendor acknowledges we made no most-favoured-customer commitment. Redline validated: delete Section 7.2 in full (no Vendor-granted MFN in our favour is affected).
